snippet.title: I'm never coding this again...
snippet.description:
Yeah only 2 weeks late no big deal

Wishlist Prego Wars: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3085060/Prego_Wars/
Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/ZY7DX958pe

Someone told me multiplayer games are 10x harder to make than single player games, I did not believe them. Then I proceeded to barely scrape by this month and somehow ended up with (barely) working multiplayer using my own fully custom netcode on Unity. Heck yeah. In the actual video I show all the footage I recorded over the month as well as a description of how rawdogging networking on Unity works like I did here.

0:43 Errors 'n 'testing
3:34 The real test
8:24 How it works
12:44 End
